root_motivation: **Who:** the agent on the chatgpt and codex_cli surfaces whose project is JavaScript. **What:** publish the function it already has as a tool, with the same data bridges python gets. **Why not today:** the only source-taking kind is python, so a Node project rewrites its tool in Python or compiles a wasm component by hand.
user_persona: An agent on a Node project that publishes `kind: js` with `function main(args)` and reads `tool.js:N` errors with the offending line, the same way it would for python.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the python bwrap profile and a 20-line js tool, When 50 cold calls run, Then the bench prints cold_p95_ms=<n> and the PR records the number and the engine form chosen; n > 300 fails the test.
Given spec.source with a syntax error on line 2, When published, Then InvalidSpec carries line: 2, column, and source_line with that line's text.
Given the js runtime, When its mcphost object's keys are listed, Then they equal runner_script_registered_modules() plus call and progress.
Given a tool that throws on line 3, When called, Then error_code: tool_exception, message ends at tool.js:3, data.source_line is that line, data.families is [tool_code].
Given timeout_s: 1 and while(true){}, When called, Then tool_timeout within 2 s and the next call succeeds; Given memory_mb: 16 and an unbounded array, Then tool_oom.
Given network: none and fetch("https://example.com"), When called, Then the error names the network grant and no socket opens.
Given a spec with secrets: ["API_KEY"] whose tool returns the secret, When host.tool_test runs, Then the value is redacted in result and host.tool_logs.

scope: src/kinds/js.rs (new): JsKind, bridge prelude generated from BRIDGE_MODULES.
src/bin/mcphost-qjs.rs (new): the rquickjs runner run inside the python bwrap profile.
src/kinds/secretenv.rs (new): secret redaction and env injection shared with python.
src/main.rs, src/kinds/mod.rs, src/kinds/docs.rs: register js beside python.
docs/kinds/js.md (new), README.md, www/llms.txt: the js page and the kind list.
non_goals: TypeScript (refused with a hint), npm packages, a warm pool, the live-prod AC8 (operator-provisioned).

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does a Node project not publish its own JavaScript?
five_whys_trace.a: the only source-taking kind is python; wasm needs a hand-compiled component.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Subprocess qjs in bwrap or in-process rquickjs?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Subprocess: AC1 measured cold p95 well under the 300 ms budget, so kernel-level isolation is kept.
